title: POIneer region manifest v1
description: A completed regional release produced by POIneer.Render.

schemaVersion.description: Manifest contract version. Only version 1 is supported; consumers must reject unsupported versions without fallback.

regionId.description: Stable region identifier consisting of slash-separated path segments.

publishedAt.description: Valid UTC publication timestamp with uppercase T and trailing Z; fractional seconds are optional, numeric offsets are not allowed. Validators must enable date-time format validation.

artifacts.description: Exactly one SQLite artifact and optionally one PMTiles artifact. Duplicate and unknown artifact types are rejected.

type.description: Artifact type and file extension. Supported types are sqlite and pmtiles; additional types require a contract extension.

objectKey.description: Lowercase relative key resolved from the configured storage root, not the manifest directory; no URL, leading slash or traversal segments. Filename: <region-name>.<artifactVersion>.<type>. Runtime contract validation must check that the region name, version and extension match the corresponding manifest fields.

sha256.description: Full SHA-256 digest of the artifact file bytes, encoded as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters without a prefix, separators or Base64.

artifactVersion.description: Explicit version of this artifact, required even when equal to releaseVersion.
